notes: Transcribed from the General Catalog NanoEngineering program page. All courses except NANO 4 must be taken for a letter grade of C- or better. The five upper-division NANO electives exclude NANO 195/197/198; NANO 199 counts only under restricted conditions, so the elective range here stops at 194.

buckets.label: NanoEngineering Lower Division
buckets.note: NANO 4 is the one-unit seminar and is the only course in the major that need not be letter-graded. NANO 15 is the programming requirement.

buckets.label: NanoEngineering Core
buckets.note: NANO 107 (circuits) and NANO 108 (circuits lab) are the engineering-preparation pair; the rest is the core sequence.

buckets.label: NanoEngineering Electives
buckets.note: Five upper-division NANO courses beyond the core. NANO 195, 197 and 198 never count; NANO 199 only by petition.
